literal_meaning: কাঠি পড়ে যাওয়া (stick or pole falling)
figurative_meaning_en: The commencement of a ceremony or festival
example_sentences_in_bangla: চড়ক পূজার কাঠি পড়েছে, উৎসব শুরু হয়েছে।
দুর্গাপূজার কাঠি পড়ার সঙ্গে সঙ্গে শহরে উল্লাস ছড়িয়ে পড়ে।
example_sentences_in_english: The Charak Puja has begun with the falling of the kathi.
The Durga Puja festivities kick off as the kathi falls.
history: Refers to the ritual erection and symbolic 'fall' or installation of bamboo poles (kathi) in festivals like Charak Puja, marking the official start; also used for Durga Puja preparations in Bengali tradition.
note: Primarily associated with Hindu festivals in Bengal, evoking excitement for upcoming celebrations.
